svg.aria-label: How CyberRiskScape connects with surrounding systems (overview)
svg.text: How CyberRiskScape connects with surrounding systems (overview)
Only implemented integrations are shown. For each product's steps, follow the links in "Products you can integrate with" below.
CyberRiskScape never writes to products. API imports run from the CLI, read-only (keys in environment variables)
UI · CLI · GitHub Action · MCP server (same engine)
Diagram (nodes, flows, boundaries) · findings · assets · BOM · business context · human decisions
People decide: risk acceptance and ratings, which threat or node a finding belongs to (ledger), and detection logic (Sigma output is a draft only)
Data stays local (IndexedDB, JSON files); model data is not sent outside. People accept risk and change ratings (MCP cannot).
